firewall {
    ipv4 {
        name DMZ-TO-INTERNAL {
            default-action drop
            description dmz-to-internal
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description web1-ping-user1
                destination {
                    address 10.10.10.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                }
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description app1-ping-user1
                destination {
                    address 10.10.10.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.50.10
                }
            }
            rule 40 {
                action accept
                description web1-ping-guest1
                destination {
                    address 10.10.20.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                }
            }
            rule 50 {
                action accept
                description app1-ping-finance1
                destination {
                    address 10.10.30.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.50.10
                }
            }
        }
        name DMZ-TO-OUTSIDE {
            default-action drop
            description dmz-to-outside
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description web1-ping-outside
                destination {
                    address 203.0.113.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                }
            }
        }
        name INTERNAL-TO-DMZ {
            default-action drop
            description internal-to-dmz
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description user1-to-web
                destination {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                    port 80
                }
                protocol tcp
                source {
                    address 10.10.10.10
                }
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description user1-ping-web
                destination {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.10.10
                }
            }
            rule 40 {
                action accept
                description user1-to-app
                destination {
                    address 10.10.50.10
                    port 5201
                }
                protocol tcp
                source {
                    address 10.10.10.10
                }
            }
            rule 50 {
                action accept
                description user1-ping-app
                destination {
                    address 10.10.50.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.10.10
                }
            }
            rule 60 {
                action accept
                description guest1-to-web
                destination {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                    port 80
                }
                protocol tcp
                source {
                    address 10.10.20.10
                }
            }
            rule 70 {
                action accept
                description guest1-ping-web
                destination {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.20.10
                }
            }
            rule 80 {
                action accept
                description finance1-to-app
                destination {
                    address 10.10.50.10
                    port 5201
                }
                protocol tcp
                source {
                    address 10.10.30.10
                }
            }
            rule 90 {
                action accept
                description finance1-ping-app
                destination {
                    address 10.10.50.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 10.10.30.10
                }
            }
            rule 100 {
                action accept
                description admin-to-dmz
                source {
                    address 10.10.99.100
                }
            }
        }
        name INTERNAL-TO-OUTSIDE {
            default-action drop
            description internal-to-outside
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description internal-http-out
                destination {
                    port 80
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description internal-tls-out
                destination {
                    port 443
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 40 {
                action accept
                description internal-ping-out
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
            rule 50 {
                action accept
                description admin-to-outside
                source {
                    address 10.10.99.100
                }
            }
        }
        name OUTSIDE-TO-DMZ {
            default-action drop
            description outside-to-dmz
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description internet-to-web
                destination {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                    port 80
                }
                protocol tcp
                source {
                    address 203.0.113.10
                }
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description internet-ping-web
                destination {
                    address 10.10.40.10
                }
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
                source {
                    address 203.0.113.10
                }
            }
        }
        name OUTSIDE-TO-INTERNAL {
            default-action drop
            description outside-to-internal
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
        }
    }
    zone DMZ {
        description dmz-zone
        from INTERNAL {
            firewall {
                name INTERNAL-TO-DMZ
            }
        }
        interface eth2
        interface eth3
    }
    zone INTERNAL {
        description internal-zone
        from DMZ {
            firewall {
                name DMZ-TO-INTERNAL
            }
        }
        from OUTSIDE {
            firewall {
                name OUTSIDE-TO-INTERNAL
            }
        }
        interface eth1
    }
    zone OUTSIDE {
        description outside-zone
        from DMZ {
            firewall {
                name DMZ-TO-OUTSIDE
            }
        }
        from INTERNAL {
            firewall {
                name INTERNAL-TO-OUTSIDE
            }
        }
        interface eth4
    }
}
interfaces {
    ethernet eth1 {
        address 10.255.1.2/30
        description transit-to-fw-int
    }
    ethernet eth2 {
        address 10.10.40.1/24
        description dmz-web-gateway
    }
    ethernet eth3 {
        address 10.10.50.1/24
        description dmz-app-gateway
    }
    ethernet eth4 {
        address 203.0.113.1/24
        description outside-gateway
    }
    loopback lo {
    }
}
nat {
    destination {
        rule 10 {
            description publish-web
            destination {
                port 80
            }
            inbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            protocol tcp
            translation {
                address 10.10.40.10
            }
        }
        rule 11 {
            description publish-web-icmp
            inbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            protocol icmp
            translation {
                address 10.10.40.10
            }
        }
    }
    source {
        rule 101 {
            description users-masquerade
            outbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            source {
                address 10.10.10.0/24
            }
            translation {
                address masquerade
            }
        }
        rule 102 {
            description guest-masquerade
            outbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            source {
                address 10.10.20.0/24
            }
            translation {
                address masquerade
            }
        }
        rule 103 {
            description finance-masquerade
            outbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            source {
                address 10.10.30.0/24
            }
            translation {
                address masquerade
            }
        }
        rule 104 {
            description mgmt-masquerade
            outbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            source {
                address 10.10.99.0/24
            }
            translation {
                address masquerade
            }
        }
        rule 105 {
            description dmz-web-masquerade
            outbound-interface {
                name eth4
            }
            source {
                address 10.10.40.0/24
            }
            translation {
                address masquerade
            }
        }
    }
}
pki {
    ca clab {
        certificate 
    }
    certificate self {
        certificate 
        private {
            key 
        }
    }
}
protocols {
    static {
        route 10.10.10.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.1 {
            }
        }
        route 10.10.20.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.1 {
            }
        }
        route 10.10.30.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.1 {
            }
        }
        route 10.10.99.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.1 {
            }
        }
    }
}
service {
    https {
        api {
            keys {
                id admin {
                    key admin
                }
            }
        }
        certificates {
            ca-certificate clab
            certificate self
        }
        listen-address 0.0.0.0
    }
    ntp {
        allow-client {
            address 127.0.0.0/8
            address 169.254.0.0/16
            address 10.0.0.0/8
            address 172.16.0.0/12
            address 192.168.0.0/16
            address ::1/128
            address fe80::/10
            address fc00::/7
        }
        server time1.vyos.net {
        }
        server time2.vyos.net {
        }
        server time3.vyos.net {
        }
    }
    ssh {
        listen-address 0.0.0.0
    }
}
system {
    config-management {
        commit-revisions 100
    }
    console {
        device ttyS0 {
            speed 115200
        }
    }
    host-name fw-ext
    login {
        user admin {
            authentication {
                encrypted-password $6$rounds=656000$vV3MsW1J6k6tjcuh$F1x0BTF.3x6M9PoHjg4WNS8sR4cHnHGwE100pbj9ltST1vJHXcwAsOJgc812t3HicrcGMlN4kvf6V5NTNqlFO.
                public-keys clab {
                    key AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINqS93spjlcsRyDTjxTQjLXqdjO7+K06cEdOPdW9YyPI
                    type ssh-ed25519
                }
            }
        }
    }
    syslog {
        global {
            facility all {
                level info
            }
            facility local7 {
                level debug
            }
        }
    }
}
